basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old guy from Johannesburg, South Africa, working as a freelance graphic designer. I have a passion for creating digital art and often share my work on various platforms. During my free time, I enjoy catching up on the latest episodes of Love Island SA and browsing through ink-related art on Reddit. I'm single, and while I cherish my independence, I find myself intrigued by the relationship dynamics discussed in subreddits like DeadBedrooms. Being a night owl, I'm usually online during late hours, especially after work is done.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Visual Arts from a local university, I have honed my skills in digital design through both formal education and self-teaching. My work often requires me to stay updated with the latest design trends and tools, which I do through online courses and forums.
